{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "White silk blouse with a relaxed collar, straight cut, knee-length hem, #ffffff color, 100% pure silk
Cream wool-blend trousers, wide-leg cut, ankle length, #f5f0e6 color, fine melton wool
Beige suede loafers, classic cap-toe design, medium heel height, #c9b89e color, soft nappa leather
Gold-plated minimalist pendant necklace and structured tote bag with tan leather straps
This outfit works because the crisp white blouse and tailored cream trousers convey professionalism essential for an analyst role at a bank. The natural wool fabric in autumn provides a sophisticated texture that feels grounded and serious without appearing overly rigid. As daylight is bright, the neutral palette ensures she looks polished and composed during the morning interview."}
